name: Blackjack
description: Three players against a dealer with a fixed house policy: bets, hit, stand, double down, 3:2 blackjacks, and a dealer who hits or stands on soft 17.

brief.situation: Three players sit at a blackjack table with {$inputs.starting_chips} chips each and play up to {$inputs.hands} hands against the house.
brief.rules: Each hand: bet {$inputs.min_bet} to {$inputs.max_bet} chips. You and the dealer get two cards; players' cards are face up, the dealer shows one card and hides the other. Values: 2 to 10 as marked, J Q K count 10, an ace counts 11 or 1. On your turn hit (take a card) as often as you like, stand, or double down on your first two cards (double your bet and take exactly one more card). Going over 21 busts and loses at once. Then the dealer reveals the hidden card and draws until reaching 17 or more{$' (and also draws on a soft 17)' if $inputs.dealer_hits_soft_17 else ' (standing on every 17)'}. Beat the dealer without busting to win your bet; a tie returns it. A blackjack (an ace and a ten-value card as your first two cards) pays 3 to 2 unless the dealer has one too. If the dealer starts with blackjack, the hand ends at once.

roles.player: You want to leave the table with as many chips as possible.

dealer_hits_soft_17.description: The dealer draws on a soft 17 (an ace counted as 11) instead of standing.

net.description: Chips won or lost so far.

stand.description: Keep your total and end your turn.

when.why: You are not playing a hand.

double_down.description: Double your bet and take exactly one more card (first two cards only).

when.why: You can only double down on your first two cards.
You do not have enough chips to double your bet.

double_down.outcome: You doubled to {$actor.wager} and drew {$card_names($world.cards_drawn)}: total {$blackjack_value($hand($actor))}.

stages.brief: Your total is {$blackjack_value($hand($actor))}{$' (soft)' if $blackjack_soft($hand($actor)) else ''}. The dealer shows {$card_names($filter($hand($entity(dealer)), $card_visible($it, $actor)))}.

you.show: Your chips {chips} · bet this hand {wager} · total {$blackjack_value($hand($actor))}{$' (soft)' if $blackjack_soft($hand($actor)) else ''}

players.title: Players

do.say: The dealer turns over the hidden card: {$card_names($hand($house))}.

do.if: $any(player, $it.wager > 0 and $blackjack_value($hand($it)) <= 21 and not ($len($hand($it)) == 2 and $blackjack_value($hand($it)) == 21 and not $it.doubled))

do: $pay = 0 if $v > 21 else ($it.wager * 2 + $it.wager // 2 if $bj and not $dealer_bj else ($it.wager if $bj else ($it.wager * 2 if $d > 21 or $v > $d else ($it.wager if $v == $d and not $dealer_bj else 0))))
$it.result = 'bust' if $v > 21 else ('blackjack' if $bj and not $dealer_bj else ('win' if $pay > $it.wager else ('push' if $pay == $it.wager else 'lose')))

net_results.description: Chips won (+) or lost (-) by each player.

end.name: table_empty
end.say: Nobody can afford the minimum bet any more.
